body: **Texto do dia:** transcrição de palestra e podcast.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (B2):** eu consigo usar substantivo + that-clause (the fact that, evidence that, the belief that) para apresentar evidências numa palestra sobre clima.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Lecture: How Do We Know the Planet Is Warming?
paras: Good morning. **The fact that** global temperatures are rising is supported by many sources. **The evidence that** glaciers are shrinking comes from satellites. **The claim that** it’s only natural variation has been tested and **the conclusion that** humans are the main cause is widely accepted.
**There is a possibility that** some effects will arrive faster than predicted, and **the idea that** we can wait is risky.

items.q: The lecturer says the evidence comes from satellites.
The claim of natural variation was never tested.
The idea that we can wait is described as safe.

head: Substantivo
Exemplo
rows: **The fact that** it is warming is clear.
**Evidence that** seas are rising is strong.
**The belief that** it’s natural is weak.
**The possibility that** floods increase is real.

blocks.body: Substantivos abstratos aceitam **that + oração completa**: fact, evidence, claim, idea, belief, possibility, conclusion. Em textos formais o **that** quase nunca cai.

items.s: The ___ that seas are rising is strong. (evidence)
The ___ that humans cause it is accepted. (conclusion)
The ___ that we can wait is risky. (idea)
There is a ___ that floods will increase. (possibility)

body: **Beyond a doubt.** — Sem sombra de dúvida.
**The evidence points to…** — A evidência aponta para…
**Take it with a grain of salt.** — Ver com ceticismo.
**What is the evidence that it’s warming?** — Qual é a evidência de que está esquentando?
**Satellites show that glaciers are shrinking.** — Satélites mostram que as geleiras estão encolhendo.
**What about the claim that it’s natural?** — E a alegação de que é natural?

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
